title: The localizing category is locally small with split idempotents
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $\Lambda$ be one of the condensed coefficient rings listed, with its coefficient data and topology, in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Work with small sites and sums in the fixed universe of [def-weil-size-convention]. The full subcategory $\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$ of $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ defined in [sk-def-localizing-closure] is locally small and triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category], has arbitrary small direct sums, and has split idempotents: for every $e:K\to K$ with $e\circ e=e$, there are an object $J$ of this subcategory and maps $i:J\to K$, $p:K\to J$ in it with $i\circ p=e$ and $p\circ i=\mathrm{id}_J$.

proof.text: Use the actual pulled-back commutative ring object Lambda_X of sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients. Pro-etale abelian sheaves in universe u+1 are Grothendieck by lem-sfb-proetale-sheaves-grothendieck, with the existing additive closed tensor structure of lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed. Apply the already proved internal-module theorem lem-sfb-modobj-grothendieck directly to Lambda_X. Thus C = Mod(Sheaf(X_proet, Ab), Lambda_X) is Grothendieck abelian in universe u+1. This avoids reconstructing sectionwise ring sheaves and transporting their module category across an equivalence.

The Grothendieck instance supplies K-injective resolutions by lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective. Apply the existing DerivedCategory.locallySmall instance, lem-pc-derived-category-locally-small, to C, using the derived localization model from def-weil-abstract-derived-category. Apply lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts to the same C, whose u+1-small coproducts follow from its Grothendieck property. This gives locally u+1-small Hom sets and u+1-small coproducts in the ambient derived category, including the empty coproduct.

Let P be localizingClosureProEtale Lambda X, the intersection in sk-def-localizing-closure. Isomorphism closure holds by applying prop_of_iso in each localizing candidate Q. The common ambient zero belongs to every Q by prop_zero. Shift closure is proved by applying Q.le_shift to the membership in every Q. For a distinguished triangle with first and third vertices in P, apply Q.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed_2 in each Q; its middle vertex then lies in P. These give P.IsTriangulated by def-weil-triangulated-subcategory. For any existing ambient discrete colimit of objects of P, every Q contains its diagram objects, hence its chosen colimit by its defining coproduct closure. Transport along the unique colimit isomorphism to any colimit presentation. This proves P.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape for the object-universe indexing sets of the original closure. Restrict this closure to u+1-small index types using the equivalence between Discrete(ULift I) and Discrete I. Mathlib Limits.hasColimitsOfShape_of_closedUnderColimits then gives u+1-small coproducts in P.FullSubcategory. Finally fullness of P.ι transfers ambient local smallness via locallySmall_of_faithful.

Install the triangulated property and coproduct instances just proved on P.FullSubcategory. The full subcategory has the inherited zero object, additive integer shifts and pretriangulated structure. Apply lem-countable-coproducts-idempotent-complete inside P.FullSubcategory to obtain IsIdempotentComplete. Pair this with local smallness, P.IsTriangulated and coproduct existence to obtain the four original clauses, with every original hypothesis unchanged.

split_report.summary: Expanded the imported three-paragraph argument into six steps. Identified internal modules over the actual pulled-back condensed ring with modules over its ring sheaf before applying the existing Grothendieck theorem; computed small Hom sets via the existing K-injective resolution and Hom-comparison nodes; proved inheritance of the ambient triangulation and coproduct universal property by the intersection definition; applied the existing countable-coproduct idempotent-completeness node inside the localizing category. Clarified the implicit scheme and indexing universe in the statement, without changing the coefficients or conclusion. No new nodes or Mathlib leaves. Second reading uses the existing internal-abelian-sheaf-module equivalence, verifies its monoidal-sheafification and commutative-ring hypotheses, and writes out preservation of the Grothendieck axioms through that equivalence.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the locally-small paragraph by steps 1-3, the triangulated-with-sums paragraph by steps 4-5, and the idempotents paragraph by step 6 of main-20261015 sk-lem-brown-hypotheses-ambient.proof.md; these are the ambient part of step 1 of unit sk-lem-brown-hypotheses.
